neighbours.label: marking something as historically or life-changingly important ('changed the course of history', 'most important', 'change your life forever')
fire: That single vote changed the course of American politics for good.
In 1848 they drafted the most important pamphlet of the age.
One phone call can change everything you thought you knew forever.
This invention changed the history of medicine in a single decade.
It remains the most important speech in the nation's history.
The night of the fire, everything changed for the people of the town.
Few books have changed the world as deeply as this one did.
Her discovery would change the way humans see the universe forever.
quiet: That single vote renewed the contract for the American supplier this year.
In 1848 they drafted a short pamphlet about the local fair.
One phone call can confirm the time of your dental visit tomorrow.
This invention changed the shape of the medicine bottle in a small way.
It remains a pleasant speech at the nation's annual trade dinner.
The night of the fire, the people of the town went to bed early.
Few books have changed hands as cheaply as this one did.
Her discovery of a coupon would change the way she buys her groceries.

predictions: 6/8 fire; the same verbs on mundane objects stay quiet
notes: The output direction promotes ' pivotal', ' foundational', ' groundbreaking', ' transformative', ' changed'.
